hero_description: Thoughtfully designed wedding and event stationery that tells your story, celebrates your style and makes every little detail feel special.
collections_intro: From the first save the date to the finishing touches on your big day, we're here to make your vision feel beautifully yours.
collection_1_description: Save the dates, invitations, RSVP cards and all the lovely extras.
collection_2_description: Welcome signs, table plans, place cards, menus and more.
collection_3_description: Personalised stationery for life's other beautiful moments.
about_description: After struggling to find stationery we loved, we started to create  our own and have fallen in love with it. I want to make stationery that feels like you. Whether your style is modern and minimal, soft and romantic or something completely different, every detail is considered with care.
about_description_two: We believe beautiful stationery should be as memorable as the occasion itself — and the experience of creating it should be just as lovely.
contact_intro: Every event is different, so we create each quote around your ideas, quantities and finishing touches. Fill in a few details below and we’ll get back to you to discuss your stationery.
